title: 船坞 Chuan Wu
subtitle: Yuanming Yuan

model.line: 1 boxes stand in this compound, 1 on blocks drawn on the plan, 0 assumed. Its halls are listed below.

evidence.title: 圆明三园中的船坞
evidence.summary: Nine docks across the three gardens, two in Qichun. 松风萝月 dock on the north of the back lake, facing east, boats 般若观 and 浮汉槎. 喜雨山房 dock on the west of the back lake, on a north-south line, joining the long river to the south. Z-QN01, Z-QN02 fit by position only; which is which is ours.

searched: No picture of it found in the Forty Scenes album, its 1745 woodcuts, the Bertin gouaches and the 1887 lithograph; the 20 Xiyang Lou plates; ruin photographs on Commons, at Östasiatiska museet, the Slovene Ethnographic Museum, Historical Photographs of China, the Rijksmuseum, Wellcome and in NDL's albums of about 1900; today's photographs on Commons.

plan_ref.text: Drawn on the plan of the gardens (S01), labelled 船坞.
